mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have a temperature of 65 degrees, which feels like 67, under dense drizzle at Reddan Soccer Park.

October has been proclaimed Community Planning Month in the City of Verona to honor our Planning and Development Department. Also, residents may soon receive letters to schedule water cross-connection surveys to ensure our water supply remains clean and safe.
We have a busy schedule today, including Yoga at Insight Wellness and trivia at Hop Haus Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard tomorrow.
In our weekly update, on September 24, an 11-year-old child was involved in a collision with a vehicle while riding a bicycle, but thankfully, no hospital transport was required.
Today's delicious flavor is Chocolate Heath Crunch. The restaurant is currently open and will remain open for you to enjoy your treat until 10 PM tonight.
